name: Research
description: Represents the controls of a Research query.
remarks: When working with Research queries, you must have an existing GUID that corresponds to a live data source. If the data source is unavailable or does not exist, a run-time error occurs.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

methods.name: Query
methods.signature: Query(ServiceID As String, [QueryString As Variant], [QueryLanguage As Variant], [UseSelection As Variant], [LaunchQuery As Variant]) As Variant

parameters.name: ServiceID
parameters.description: Specifies a GUID that identifies the research service.

parameters.name: QueryLanguage
parameters.description: Specifies the query language of the query string.

parameters.name: UseSelection
parameters.description: True to use the current selection as the query string. This overrides the _QueryString_ parameter if set. Default value is False.

parameters.name: LaunchQuery
parameters.description: True launches the query. False displays the Research task pane scoped to search the specified research service.

methods.name: IsResearchService
methods.description: Indicates whether the GUID specified in the _ServiceID_ parameter corresponds to a currently configured service.

parameters.name: ServiceID
parameters.description: Specifies a GUID that identifies the research service.

methods.name: SetLanguagePair
methods.signature: SetLanguagePair(LanguageFrom As Long, LanguageTo As Long) As Variant
methods.description: Sets the languages for the translation service.

parameters.name: LanguageFrom
parameters.description: Specifies the language to translate from.

parameters.name: LanguageTo
parameters.description: Specifies the language to translate to.
